objective: A real local-model, three-round finite hypothesis/refinement campaign. Request two simple causal hypotheses per round; retain invalid, duplicate, rejected and failed attempts without refunds or retries. Later rounds inherit the previous round's first two evaluated proposal IDs and exact research feedback. Final selection is at most the first three numerically screen-admitted proposal IDs, with no winner ranking or formula edits. Use the unchanged model gate once if nonempty. All adaptive statistics are exploratory; no protected data or independent-alpha claim. Use the schema-constrained endpoint after the two preserved invalid-only JSON-mode campaigns. Earlier attempts remain charged and frozen; the parser and numerical gates stay unchanged. This new finite engineering campaign freezes authoritative DSL-derived calculation metadata; raw model declarations and all prior failed campaign attempts remain preserved. Equations and directions are never repaired by metadata enrichment.
